plan.change: Implementer creates one new file smoke/S392923308-2.md whose only line is `S392923308-2 — Budget exhaustion sentinel` (first line contains the exact issue key, em-dash title mirrors the repo convention seen in smoke/S394388429-1.md). No other file changes.
ordering: Bind to LEGION_WORKSPACE; jj new off the branch head.
Write smoke/S392923308-2.md as a single line naming S392923308-2.

acceptance.criterion: A1 new file exists on PR branch
A2 single line on the initial/adding commit names the issue
acceptance.surface: PR branch VCS history (the revision that first adds the file)
acceptance.command: jj file show -r <adding-rev> smoke/S392923308-2.md | grep -c '' equals 1 AND head -1 contains S392923308-2

acceptance.criterion: A3 only smoke/S392923308-2.md changes across the PR; reviewer may append further lines to that same file

plan.ci: .github/workflows/ci.yml is a no-op pass (sleep 20 && exit 0); fail-on-demand.yml fails only if a .fail-me file exists. No gate validates the smoke file; proof surface is filesystem + VCS diff on the PR branch.

implement: legion-worker: governs workspace binding, jj commit/push, PR creation, and proving the change on the PR surface; no repo-domain skill applies to a one-line Markdown file (no AGENTS.md, no build).
test: legion-worker: governs re-running the named A1/A2/A3 proving commands on the PR branch and reporting the CI verdict.
review: legion-worker: governs the review round and the spec-sanctioned request to append further issue-naming lines to the same file.

findings.finding: A2 is temporal (single line on initial commit) while A3 permits reviewer-appended lines, so PR HEAD legitimately grows; the single-line check cannot read final state.
findings.answer: Plan pins A2 to the blob at the revision that first adds the file: jj file show -r <adding-rev> smoke/S392923308-2.md, asserting exactly one line and that it contains the key.

findings.finding: Ambiguity: 'a single line that names this issue' could mean the line equals the key or merely contains it.
findings.answer: Plan adopts the convention reading: first line contains the exact key substring S392923308-2 plus an em-dash title; content is `S392923308-2 — Budget exhaustion sentinel`. Check: head -1 contains S392923308-2.

findings.finding: Filename must be the full key smoke/S392923308-2.md (suffix included).
findings.answer: Confirmed; plan targets exactly smoke/S392923308-2.md, which does not yet exist. Check: test -f.
